verdict.rationale: jo's docs say it keeps the 'same memory and context' across macOS, Telegram, WhatsApp, and email, and runs on a per-user machine with its own storage. That implies persistent memory carried between conversations, but how memory is captured, recalled, or applied to new chats is not described. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of recalling prior-chat context in new conversations, memory management or controls, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can have the assistant remember relevant context from previous chats and apply it in new conversations

citations.quote: same memory and context across all of them
Every user gets their own isolated cloud machine with its own storage. It lets jo keep working across devices
